title: Re-cite remaining vtc-server tests to spec 77c3474
description: Found in batch 41 (JMAP-z4z0.10): after call_state.rs was re-cited, 8 vtc-server test files still pin jmap-chat-spec 3227c0f or 33702a5: tests/participant.rs, tests/common/mod.rs, tests/livestream.rs, tests/call_create.rs, tests/call_query.rs, tests/recording.rs, tests/call_end_cascade.rs, tests/delivery.rs. Re-cite every spec citation and quote in crate-jmap-vtc-server (tests and src) against 77c3474: correct line numbers, verbatim wording, correct BCP 14 keyword. Several old MUSTs are SHOULD at 77c3474 (e.g. old L706/L1207 moderator forbidden -> L900/L904/L1258/L1356, old L406 e2ee forbidden -> L480, old L1647 privilege escalation MUST gone); where the crate enforces a SHOULD, say it does so by choice; where the draft says nothing (e.g. VTCCall destroy), say the behaviour is crate choice. Re-pin file headers to 77c3474 once every cite in the file matches. Comment-only; no assertion, logic, CHANGELOG or public-api change. Goal: no further vtc re-cite follow-ups.
